segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on your admin account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Ben with Northstar Packaging. Email is ben.keller@northstarpackaging.com. I just need to add five seats to our account for the operations team.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. I’m pulling up the account in the admin console now. Okay, I see you’re on the Business plan with 42 active seats, billed monthly. You want to go to 47 seats today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. Ideally effective today, April 18. We’ve got a training session at 2:00, so I’m trying to get the invites out before then.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem. The prorated charge for the five seats through the end of your current billing period, May 1, is $86.30. It’ll appear on invoice 48219, and then your regular monthly total will update to $1,410 starting May 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I expected. Go ahead and add them.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. Your seat limit is now 47. You can invite the users from Admin, Users, then Add user. I’m also sending a confirmation to your billing contact and your admin email.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. I see the limit updated on my side already. Thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. I’ve logged this under ticket 317842 in case you need the record. Anything else I can help with today?
